dedupe_keys.name: code underlying the publication efficient sequential neural network based on spatial temporal attention and linear lstm for robust lane detection using multi frame images

description: TU Delft provides lane-detection source code and a pretrained-model descriptor for a sequential neural network using spatial-temporal attention and linear LSTM. Native metadata specifies Python 3.9, PyTorch 0.4.0 and CUDA 8.0. Index descriptors use five consecutive image inputs and the last-frame ground truth. Images are described as 128 by 256 pixels, with scenes from American highways and rural Chinese roads. Coverage: A complete source observation interval is unstated. Access: public native metadata identifies this release and its stated formats. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current distribution access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: The source calls the 2024 manuscript under review; present publication status and dependency compatibility are unverified. Reported total, training and test sequence counts are not silently reconciled. Pretrained weights, code, image sequences and linked sharing credentials were not acquired or executed. Related 2023 lane-detection code is a distinct release. Its simulation use concerns road-scene lane detection using consecutive image frames.
